ios.desc:
Wonderous will educate and entertain as you uncover information about some of the most famous structures in the world.

Learn about the cultures that created them by exploring the artifacts they left behind.

Main features for each of the 8 Wonders:

• History, construction and location information
• Photo viewer with beautiful full-screen images
• Location-specific artifacts from the Open Access collection at the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
• Hidden collectables to discover

quotes.text:
Wonderous is an app we've pointed people to in the past. I believe the current iOS release on the App Store uses the newer Impeller rendering engine instead of Skia, but I could be wrong.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wonderous/id1612491897
